description: Search text normalization (FR-CAT-04). The API applies it to the stored search column and to the query; the app applies it to local (offline) search. Both must give these exact outputs.
rules: 1. Remove Arabic diacritics U+064B..U+065F and U+0670, and tatweel U+0640.
3. Map ة U+0629 to ه U+0647.
4. Map ى U+0649 to ي U+064A.
5. Map Arabic-Indic digits U+0660..U+0669 and Extended Arabic-Indic digits U+06F0..U+06F9 to 0..9.
7. Collapse runs of whitespace to one space and trim.
